answer: A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 14 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. The nectar chain is verified at intake and gale publishes each anchor. To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 14 epochs old, anchored at a reef checkpoint. That bill is paid per identity, so 175 aliases cost 393 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
